title: Croatian Frittata
description: A traditional Croatian egg dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch. Frittatas are a great way to use up leftover ingredients.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the Croatian sausage over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the cooked sausage and onion mixture in the skillet.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with shredded cheese.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
